stem: A small block of mass 0.1 kg lies on fixed inclined plane PQ which makes an angle θ with the horizontal. A horizontal force of 1 N is applied on the block directed up the slope. The block remains stationary. Choose INCORRECT statement:

options.A: If surface is smooth, the angle θ = $45{^\circ}$
options.B: If the angle is θ < $45{^\circ}$, then the friction force must be acting up the slope
options.C: If the angle is θ < $45{^\circ}$, then the friction force must be acting down the slope
options.D: If the angle is θ > $45{^\circ}$, then the friction force must be acting up the slope

assets.alt: A block on a 30° incline with a horizontal 1 N push and its 1 N weight. Note: along the slope, push cos θ up and weight sin θ down.
